userReport: Agent recovery appears frequently after repeated A/B cursor crossings.

beforeTrace.interpretation: A lost trust-validation freshness while runtime samples also show a delayed timer and a GC stopping/pause observation above one second. B observed remote EOF on the matching connection. Different PC wall clocks do not establish subsecond event ordering.
limitations: 5389639 microseconds measures sampler lateness, not an exact GC stop duration.
A trust read active in a native open does not establish that filesystem or ACL work caused the process delay.
The two clean source retirements before expiry are not themselves proof of failed native cleanup.
